_comment: Field-name -> sky-pointing lookup for canonical-width auto-compute. Keys are the categorical field names used as the RCD filename prefix (e.g. 'field1'..'field24'); values give the field-center pointing in DEGREES as {'ra_deg': <ICRS RA>, 'dec_deg': <ICRS Dec>}. THESE ARE PLACEHOLDERS spread along the ecliptic (where KBO occultation fields sit) and MUST be replaced with the observatory's real field-center table. A field that is absent from this file is NOT an error: width.canonical_width_frames falls back to config.width_at_opposition for any unknown name.
